status: FastAPI selected in source; current release audit patches recorded; functional QA and platform execution remain pending

core.description: Dependency-check profile for the four core minimums; applicable to manually prepared headless environments
core.runtime_headless_condition: WEB_ENABLED=false prevents ASGI import and construction; --profile core only selects checker scope
core.resource_measurement_status: Not measured; previously stated RSS range withdrawn

web.description: Default production dependency-check profile: four core minimums plus six evaluated ASGI exact pins
web.pyproject_extra_role: Compatibility alias; ASGI pins are also in project.dependencies
web.version_policy: Exact metadata version equality; alternate releases, pre/dev/post releases and local builds are rejected
web.resource_measurement_status: Not measured; previously stated RSS range withdrawn

installer_contracts.unknown_profile_policy: Fail before package imports; never silently fall back to core
installer_contracts.rollback_model: Journaled replacement and attempted recovery of individual components; rollback can fail and then staging is retained
installer_contracts.atomicity_scope: Each successful os.replace on the same filesystem; no complete-tree transaction or power-loss guarantee
installer_contracts.operational_preservation_scope: Release components exclude .env and the default data/, data/maps/ and logs/ directories. Arbitrary custom paths within replaced components are not covered by that exclusion; environment and application files are replaced

process_model.uvicorn_embedding: uvicorn.Server.serve() called directly in loop without uvicorn.run or CLI reload
process_model.radio_ownership: Single owner; BridgeCore owns serial adapter; web server only borrows context
process_model.web_shutdown_budget_scope: Owner-provided common deadline for web cleanup; a static implementation intent, not a measured guarantee for the complete bridge or workers

codebase_accounting.status: Historical reported values retained for provenance; not a current measurement or validated equivalent-set comparison
codebase_accounting.source: Original phase-6 report and registry based on a32cb14; no reproducible counting receipt was recorded
codebase_accounting.scope: Legacy stack includes dispatcher/controllers; ASGI candidate set lists transport modules and DTOs; sets are not established as comparable
codebase_accounting.native_primary_module_current_status: src/web/http_server.py removed; src/web/api_router.py and controllers remain live shared business logic

release_gates.description: Verify core/web dependency profiles on all six historical target environments; wheel resolution alone is insufficient
Verify isolated clean install and staged update with the current manifests and explicit web probes
Verify actual systemd startup and shutdown behavior
Exercise isolated component replacement and attempted rollback, including recovery failure
Verify .env and operational data preservation during update
Measure web cleanup against the owner deadline, default 1.5 seconds, and separately measure full bridge shutdown; no whole-process 1.5-second guarantee
Verify no retained sockets, orphan processes, unfinished workers or unowned asyncio tasks
Verify supported Python 3.10 runtime; current AST syntax inspection does not certify imports or behavior
AsgiWebServer selected by BridgeCore and native HTTP server removed in 933ccce; functional REST/WS/docs and deployment acceptance remain pending

evidence_scope.source: fcaf89b checkout and current layer-audit working-tree patches
evidence_scope.kind: Static source, AST, manifest, wheel METADATA and diff inspection

rectifications: Previous RSS ranges of 35-45 MB and 75-90 MB are withdrawn because no platform, workload, process or measurement method supported them.
No guarantee of SBC installation, absence of compilation, memory use, startup time or hardware support is established by the six historical wheel resolutions.
ASGI is selected in source; the native HTTP server is removed. Adoption in code does not certify deployment or operational QA.
Core is a dependency-check profile, not the default production manifest or an alternative native web server.
Rollback is an attempted multi-component recovery using individual renames, not an atomic switch of the complete installation.
